# UC-LEARN11 — Privilege LLM — prompt injection blocked

**Track:** learn  
**Maturity:** ✅ `works`  
**OWASP:** 🛡️ **OWASP ASI** — Threats: T5 · Sections: §4.2.3

## Buyer Story

A model-facing prompt can carry an instruction override that tries to bypass policy and trigger a high-impact action.

## PingOne Solution

PingOne Privilege evaluates the LLM request at the gateway and blocks the prompt before it reaches the model.

## How to Run

**Trigger:** Trigger (link): `{"type":"link","path":"/llm-gateway?attack=prompt_injection","label":"Open Privilege LLM prompt-injection run"}`  
**Expected outcome:** `DENY`

## What to Say

> The prompt says to ignore policy and move money. Privilege blocks the request at the LLM gateway; the provider never sees it.
